import sys, json, time, subprocess, resource
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *

def timed(name, env, limit=30.0):
    raw = json.dumps(env).encode()
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', MAIN], input=raw, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    el = time.time() - t0
    ok = p.returncode == 0
    try:
        d = json.loads(p.stdout)
        n = len(d["results"])
    except Exception:
        d, n = None, -1
    print(f"{name}: rc={p.returncode} time={el:.2f}s events={n} in={len(raw)/1e6:.1f}MB out={len(p.stdout)/1e6:.1f}MB")
    return el, p

# 1) 10000 events, ~2.5KB requests each -> ~30MB input
big_body = b"x" * 2000
req = mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=big_body) + [("P-Preferred-Identity", "<sip:desk@lab.test>,<tel:+12025550100>"), ("Privacy","id"), ("X-Junk", "y"*200)], body=big_body)
hexs = req.hex()
print("req bytes:", len(req), "hex chars:", len(hexs))
evs = [ev(i, "edge", "alice", "external", hexs) for i in range(10000)]
el, p = timed("10k x 2.5KB", envelope(evs, base_config(cap=10000)))

# 2) max-size single requests: 32KB header block + 32KB body
hb = std_headers() + [("X-Pad-%d" % i, "z"*200) for i in range(160)]
big2 = mkreq(headers=hb, body=b"q"*30000)
print("big2 bytes:", len(big2))
evs = [ev(i, "edge", "alice", "external", big2.hex()) for i in range(200)]
el, p = timed("200 x 32KB", envelope(evs, base_config(cap=10000)))

# 3) many PAI rows with quoted display names (slow split path)
rows = [("P-Asserted-Identity", '"Name,with,commas %d" <sip:alice@lab.test>' % i) for i in range(50)]
# only 1-2 allowed; use 1 row with many commas inside quotes
row = '"a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i,j,k,l,m,n,o,p" <sip:alice@lab.test>'
big3 = mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [("P-Asserted-Identity", row)], body=b"")
evs = [ev(i, "trunk", None, "internal", big3.hex()) for i in range(3000)]
el, p = timed("3k quoted commas", envelope(evs, base_config(cap=10000)))

# 4) long display names and long PAI rows (8KB lines)
longname = "N" * 4000
big4 = mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [("P-Asserted-Identity", f'"{longname}" <sip:alice@lab.test>'), ("From", f'"{longname}" <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t')], body=b"")
evs = [ev(i, "trunk", None, "internal", big4.hex()) for i in range(1000)]
el, p = timed("1k long display", envelope(evs, base_config(cap=10000)))

# 5) ledger at capacity 10000 with distinct keys + eviction churn
evs = []
for i in range(10000):

    evs.append(ev(i, "edge", "alice", "external", r.hex()))

d = json.loads(p.stdout); print("  live:", d["live"], "accepted:", d["accepted"])
